# <span id="aanchor154"></span> Liquid Quality Source Editor

[&lt;&lt; Back](Liquid%20Quality%20Source%20Editor.md#Tabs) \| <a href="#" class="selected">Main</a> \| [Source Analysis](Source%20Analysis%20Tab.md) \| [Characteristic](Characteristic%20Tab.md) \| [Service](Service%20Tab.md)

## Main Tab

The Main tab in the Liquid Quality Source Editor shows basic information about the source, such as the measurement area, import ID, analysis type, and fluid service. The fields that are shaded in gray such as System Name, Analysis Type, and Source Meter Number are read-only.

By default, the only fields required to save a new source are Source Number and Reason.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Field Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Main tab of the Liquid Quality Source Editor:

- **System Name** - Displays the name of the system the source belongs to.

- **Import ID** - If applicable, enter the Import ID. This is used if importing data from a third party and the source number in the file is different than the source number that is setup in FLOWCAL. This will tell FLOWCAL what source to import the data to. It can be used with text file imports or Transaction Queue.

- **Analysis Type** - Read-only field that is set to liquid when the source is created.

- **Fluid Service** - This field is only editable when users are creating a new source. The fluid service is set to "Hydrocarbon" by default; if "Nonhydrocarbon" is selected, the Nonhydrocarbon Liquid Source Analysis detail will display. After a source has been created, this field is read-only.

- **TESTit Enable** - This field by default is set to No when a source is created. You can update this field to Yes for this source to be utilized with TESTit Integrated. If you do not have TESTit Integrated, this field is hidden.

  This feature is supported by TESTit v2 Integrated only. Once this field is set to Yes, it cannot be changed due to the audit trail and the ability to link TESTit tasks to this source. Test reports are available through the Tools \> Test Reports menu on the Liquid Quality Source Editor.

- **Enable Rollups** - All quality samples are stored at the data resolution they are generated (4-minute, hourly, daily, monthly, quarterly, etc.). When Enable Rollups is checked, and the Type is Chromatograph or RTU Average, the quality samples are averaged and rolled up into daily and monthly averages. This could be useful for users handling daily and weekly chromatographs that need to report averages for a period. If the Type is Liquid Analysis, the quality is copied directly to the rollup tables.

  The rollups service (FcSrvGQAnlRollup.exe) must be installed and running. To view the result of the source rollups, go to Open \> Rollup Viewers \> Source Analysis Rollups.

- **Save Hourly Rollups** - If checked, the hourly rollup data will be saved to the database; otherwise, it is calculated on rollup, but discarded, saving database space.

- **Replace Original Only** - When checked, during imports of quality samples, only the revision zero or original data is replaced. Edits to the data are retained and are used when a sample is applied.

- **Remove Overlapping Edits** - When checked (default), during imports of quality samples, existing samples are replaced. Any edits that overlap the imported data are truncated to end where the new analysis begins and resume after it ends.

- **Ignore Duplicate Dates** - When this option is enabled, any quality source sample with the same source and sample date as an existing sample is not imported.

  When attempting to import a duplicate liquid sample through the file import service, the duplicate sample is ignored, the import is treated as successful, and a source message is generated to alert the user. When attempting to manually import, a message is generated on screen to alert the user that the sample was not imported as well as generating a source message.

- **Measurement Area** - Select a measurement area from the drop-down or, with the correct privileges, click the New button to create a new Measurement Area. Measurement areas are managed from the Measurement Area Editor.

- **Data Stream** - Informational field used to denote a data collection system or source

- **Source Meter Number** - A read-only field that displays the meter number that the source is receiving analysis from. This would be used if sending Online GC data from a meter to a source.

- **Custom Fields** - User-definable fields that can be used to accommodate company-specific information, such as division or field technician. All the labels are user-defined and are managed from the Custom Fields screen within the Settings Manager. Fields 1–5 are numeric and 6–10 are alphanumeric.

- **Liquid Analysis Comparison** - Allows a user to compare analysis samples to another liquid quality source. This is useful if multiple samples are collected and sent to different labs for analysis. On import, an exception will be generated that the comparison failed. The user can go to the Source Analysis tab and right-click on the grid to select Compare from the context menu and re-run the comparison.
